# Hourly volatility index per pair (Europe/Bucharest hours)

Source: Yahoo Finance 1h bars (FX "=X" symbols; XAUUSD = GC=F COMEX futures), fetched 2026-11-18 via Chrome.
Metric: average (high-low)/close per hourly bar, divided by the pair's average across all 24 hours, x100 (100 = average hour). Hour = bar start, Bucharest time.
Samples: W (EU+US winter time) = 2025-11-03..2026-03-06 + 2026-11-02..2026-11-18, 75 days per hour. S (summer) = 2026-04-06..2026-09-25, 100 days per hour. 23 Dec-2 Jan excluded.
Caveat: hours 23-01 (W) / 23-02 (S) are inflated by rollover spread widening in indicative quotes; not tradable volatility.
